name: qwang07
description: qwang07 的插件集：WeCom MCP 工具、Archify 交互架构与流程图、Milestone 项目目标与进度面板、CodeGraph 本地语义代码图谱、Sealos Cloud 部署运维、Memdex 跨项目本地记忆

plugins.name: wecom
plugins.description: 79 WeCom tools, 8 resources, and 3 prompts — Contact, Approval, Drive, and Doc/Smartsheet/Form modules over MCP. Prompts for corp credentials on enable; the secret goes to the system keychain.

plugins.name: archify
plugins.description: Interactive architecture, workflow and sequence diagrams, plus source-backed one-page explainers. Unmodified upstream skill, automatically synchronized daily.

plugins.name: milestone
plugins.description: Project goals, deliverables, and live progress in a panel beside the conversation.

plugins.name: codegraph
plugins.description: Local-first semantic code intelligence over MCP (@colbymchenry/codegraph@latest) — surgical context, call paths, and blast-radius analysis across 30+ languages, paired with an on-demand CLI skill.

plugins.name: sealos
plugins.description: Deploy and operate Sealos Cloud apps through one interactive skill and a Brain managed workflow — deploy from the template store, Docker images, or source code, and manage databases, object storage, domains, and logs.

plugins.name: memdex
plugins.description: Local-first cross-project conversation memory: SessionStart memory index, incremental Stop-hook syncing, and Chinese/English MCP recall over SQLite FTS5.
